title: When a positive SIMP density floor is not enough: solver admissibility and guarded floor selection in matrix-free 3D topology optimization
summary: In a matrix-free geometric-multigrid FGMRES solver for three-dimensional SIMP topology optimization, a reported converged solve is not always a converged solve. On four of 102 held-out states, the projected residual used for stopping falls below $10^{-6}$ while a recomputed true residual is 1.35 to 49.5 times the tolerance; in an unguarded optimization trajectory, 22 of 40 state solves reach the iteration cap without raising an error.
